en.purpose: To derive the clinical TNM subcategory string and prognostic stage group for endometrial carcinoma using the UICC TNM Classification, 9th edition.
en.use: Use the recorded clinical T, N, and M categories to derive the TNM subcategory string (T, N, and M concatenated without separators, for example T1aN0M0) and the existing prognostic stage group. The subcategory is reported whenever all three categories are present, including when those categories do not produce an assignable stage group. Existing stage-group rules are retained.
en.misuse: Not to be used for other types of cancer.

other_details.references: O'Sullivan B, Brierley J, Byrd D, Bosman F, Kehoe S, Kossary C, Piñeros M, Van Eycken E, Weir HK, Gospodarowicz M. The TNM classification of malignant tumours-towards common understanding and reasonable expectations. Lancet Oncol. 2017 Jul;18(7):849-851. doi: 10.1016/S1470-2045(17)30438-2. PMID: 28677562; PMCID: PMC5851445.
other_details.en: An assessment tool used to assign the prognostic stage group for endometrial cancer based on the TNM classification system.
